shields_note: Posted 'Defensive Shields 10' after the starting cards, outside the 60; all ten are named (Your Insight Serves You Well is posted both as a starting Effect and as a shield).
notes: Starting cards as posted under 'Start 6': Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room, Prepared Defenses (dested Heading For The Medical Frigate), Your Insight Serves You Well, Don't Do That Again, Squadron Assignments, An Unusual Amount Of Fear; these count toward the 60. No Objective.

Posted 'Prepared Defenses' (a Dark Side card) in a Light deck dested Heading For The Medical Frigate, the Light starting Interrupt that deploys up to three Effects; the start has exactly three other Effects.

The starting Your Insight Serves You Well and Don't Do That Again dested the Effects (Death Star II and Tatooine): the strategy says he uses Don't Do That Again 'instead of the Def Shield so that I can start it'. The shield list's A Tragedy Has Occurred, Battle Plan, Aim High, Ounee Ta, Your Insight Serves You Well and Wise Advice dested the Reflections III Defensive Shield printings.

Posted 'Epp Quigon' dested Qui-Gon Jinn With Lightsaber; 'Epp Luke' Luke With Lightsaber; 'Epp Obi' Obi-Wan With Lightsaber; 'Epp Leia' Leia With Blaster Rifle; 'EPP Han' Han With Heavy Blaster Pistol; '3p0 with parts showing' Threepio With His Parts Showing; 'Squassin' Squadron Assignments; 'Haashn' Major Haash'n.
Posted 'All Wings combo', 'Houjix/Out Of Nowhere', 'Sense/Recoil in Fear' and 'OOC/TT' dested the combo Interrupts.

The author's update swaps out Your Insight, Launching The Assault, Home One, Ackbar and Haash'n for Insurrection, Home One: Docking Bay, Dash Rendar, Outrider and The Bith Shuffle & Desperate Reach. The list is kept as first published.
